correctness.rationale: PASS for a NECESSARY weak-combinatorial classification only, not existence. For 2 smooth conics and 5 lines, total degree9; cited nearly-free mdr and Tjurina formulas force exponents (4,5) and tau47. Bezout and Tjurina yield n2+2t+3n3=34 and n2+3t+4n3=47; cited arrangement inequality forces n3>=6, leaving (2,7,6),(1,6,7),(0,5,8). Reconstructed intersection parity for each line b_L congruent c_L mod2, proved at most two nodes preclude line-line nodes, and counted the line triples x<=2 via intersecting triples among five lines. One-node case forces (x,y,z)=(2,4,1) and violates parity of every conic's ten line intersections. Two-node case forces (2,4,0), and the four remaining line-line corner incidences make a four-cycle; even conic-color degrees force a monochromatic corner conic Q through all four points. Smooth Q of equation alpha X(X-Z)+beta Y(Y-Z), alpha beta !=0, cannot be tangent to the shared line Z=0, and the other conic cannot be tangent to three concurrent lines. Covers both placements of two nodes. Remaining x=1 or2 gives (y,z)=(7,0) or (4,2). Proof depends on published lower bound/Tjurina/inequality, confirmed in actual Gałecka and Dimca–Pokora source contexts. This does NOT prove realization or near freeness of the final profile.
